jitter.comparison: Personally consumed Native007 full608 actual report/fixture narrative, fresh20–102. JitterFrame/Bone/Incident/Summary are raw observations and diagnostic thresholds, not accepted animation transforms or gameplay state. Generic JitterBoneIdentity allows canonical Rig identity adapters without making report labels the identity owner. Angular acceleration/jerk and position acceleration/jerk have different dimensions; native arrays/Serialize at report port are justified, but should not erase an existing typed source before internal calculations. Diagnostics completeness is coverage evidence, not a finite-all-poses certificate.
jitter.disposition: raw diagnostic product ownership distinct from accepted rig/animation values

playback.comparison: Consumed Native004 full810 facade and exact playback narrative/tests, fresh100–173. AnimationRuntime owns native asset loading/cache, while canonical MotionKey/pack catalogue owns authored semantic identity. LoadedClip is a native handle plus admitted duration/layer; PlaybackPose is a prepared candidate, AnimationPlayback is retained ECS state, so similar fields do not imply duplicate public concepts. Contributions/foot IK fractions/cadence should remain typed across resolver and retention. AuthoredBindTransform native SDK transform preserves original bind data, different from final pose; Entity wrappers are actual ECS roles.
playback.disposition: native asset adapter and candidate/retained playback products justified

pose-buffer.comparison: Consumed Native006 full1892 actual source/tests narrative, fresh65–155. RigJointTable is canonical ordered joint storage reused for poses/entities/offsets; it is not asset membership proof and should not be replaced by unrelated Vecs. PoseBufferRig owns sampling, interpolation and handoff state. LocalPose contains native translation/quaternion/scale, different from frame-tagged Position or checked rigid transform; preserve raw invalid observations and bind fallback diagnostic policies. AuthoredWeaponTarget is a semantic preprocedural target rather than actual gameplay impact point. Shared Rig identities and typed time leaves belong below native ECS buffer orchestration.
pose-buffer.disposition: canonical rig table/clock reuse with explicit raw pose/native adapter boundary

calibration.comparison: Consumed Native008 exact full447 contact calibration narrative/tests, fresh1–64. AuthoredLocomotionCalibration combines measured stride and optional authored phase curve, not a second live cadence owner. CalibrationAxis extracts a signed component; physical phase fit, authored phase and elapsed/time are distinct. Native extrema and sampled positions are numerical work and completed measurements reenter canonical lengths/phase owners. None for no usable calibration remains availability, not zero measurement. Existing F002 neutral length relocation applies without erasing reverse/signed/singleton fit policy.
calibration.disposition: measured calibration product and distinct phase roles justified

presentation.comparison: Consumed Native009 exact full867 presentation narrative/tests, fresh20–80. PresentedSkeleton is explicitly client interpolation over authoritative SkeletonState, not a parallel gameplay authority. PresentedAttackPhase binds source tick/animation/hand/continuation to phase error; canonical phase, error delta, sample tick and span retain distinct semantics. Reuse shared leaves through prediction/correction; never persist this presentation state or derive damage authority from it. Similar source/presentation ticks remain separate roles even with common numeric owner.
presentation.disposition: presentation product distinct from authoritative tactical state

procedural.comparison: Consumed Native012 exact full1813 facade narrative/tests, fresh60–115. ProceduralLookState/JumpAnticipationState/FixedTickPoseCache and BoneSnapshot retain native Transform/Quat for local rendering work. They are not duplicate gameplay pose or geometry authority. Typed sample clocks and semantic height/angle outputs remain canonical; native recurrence amount and cached SDK matrices may remain at genuine numerical port, with raw-source breadth explicit. Generic animation NonnegativeLength still moves to neutral owner under F002, not all native Vec3 indiscriminately wrapped.
procedural.disposition: local procedural/native work records justified; semantic leaves stay shared

body-response.comparison: Consumed Native011 full490 actual response narrative/tests, fresh1–65. BodyLocalVelocity/Acceleration and BodyAngle/AngularVelocity are meaningful presentation body-frame quantities, different from scene motion or neutral angle storage. LocomotionBodyResponseState owns filtered observation/candidate recurrence, not a new canonical locomotion authority. Core/neutral numeric leaves can be shared below body wrappers; completed inverse-body transformed observations are admitted before state. Zero elapsed/None observation differ from failed source and must remain explicit.
body-response.disposition: body-frame role wrappers and local response product justified

ik-solver.comparison: Consumed Native012 full564 actual two-bone narrative/tests, fresh1–70. TwoBoneChain/Solution are local numerical solver input/output with checked segment lengths but raw native points; they do not establish a new reusable finite geometry contract. Pelvis shift SignedLength belongs to neutral measurement owner, not animation-specific length copy. Pole direction and end direction differ from persistent plan direction; no universal unit guarantee inferred from name. Coherent result/error propagation must preserve the complete solution; do not split checked lengths and raw endpoints merely to avoid API propagation.
ik-solver.disposition: local mathematical solver product justified with canonical measurement leaves

rig.comparison: Consumed Native012 full514 actual topology/axes narrative/tests, fresh1–90 and compared existing canonical Rig/MHR definitions. BoneRole27 is procedural semantic role subset, different from every MHR joint identity/fine facial/finger taxonomy, so retain that role mapping rather than merge enum by similar names. RigJointName, membership and MHR mirror convention belong to low canonical Rig; client owns live Entity binding and optional partial HumanoidRig. MirroredJointPair is native entity projection of canonical naming relation, not new durable identity. Optional sole axes and empty topology valid, no count-based same-asset proof.
rig.disposition: shared rig identity/MHR convention with client procedural roles and live binding justified
